title: Simply Optimized 2
description:
Simply Optimized 2, because simply optimized was discontinued.

Optimize Minecraft
body:
Simply Optimized 2: Optimized Minecraft Experience

As a successor to the discontinued Simply Optimized modpack, Simply Optimized 2 aims to provide a seamless and enhanced Minecraft experience. This modpack is designed to optimize Minecraft's performance, graphics, and overall gameplay.

Key Features:
- Performance Boost: Enjoy a smoother Minecraft experience with modern performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and more.
- Regular Updates: Stay up-to-date with the latest Minecraft versions and mod updates.

About Simply Optimized 2:

This modpack is built on the Fabric mod loader, ensuring a lightweight and fast experience. As an open-source project, we welcome user suggestions and collaborate with mod developers to improve the user experience.

All mods:
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise)
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling/)
- [Very Many Players (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric)
- [ScalableLux](https://modrinth.com/mod/scalablelux)
- [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling)
- [ModernFix-mVUS](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix-mvus)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [ServerCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/servercore)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [Better Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
